_note: Protocol = the paper's R code 1:1 up to the CI batch/lr deviation (see the YAML header): measured 2026-08-26 on the refactor/lean-fit branch. Paper Sec. 6.1 truth: beta12 +2, beta13 -0.2, beta23 +0.3. beta13 multiplies x1, a two-component mixture at 0.25 and 0.73 with sd 0.254 against unit-scale x2, so it is weakly identified and the fitted value sits above the truth. mean_x3_flow_do_x1 stays unpinned on purpose: the DGP center plus the abs-err bound covers it.

beta13.why: weakly identified: the coefficient multiplies the mixture x1 (sd 0.254 vs unit-scale siblings) — see the _note and docs/paper-replication.md

beta23.why: weakly identified: the coefficient multiplies the mixture x1 (sd 0.254 vs unit-scale siblings) — see the _note and docs/paper-replication.md

mean_x3_dgp_do_x1.why: a deterministic seeded DGP draw, like the other analytic entries; only numpy's last-bit drift moves it

fit_seconds.why: 3x the 2-core CI runner measurement (550 s, 2026-08-31): shared-runner wall clock is noisy, so this is a gross-regression tripwire (a lost no_grad, an accidental O(n^2)), not a benchmark
